posts.body:
July is Plastic Free July, a global movement that encourages everyone to reduce plastic waste. One simple way to make a difference is by recycling the plastics accepted in Rumpke's recycling program.

In 2025, Rumpke recycled more than 33,420 tons of plastic. With your help, we can recycle even more! Every bottle, jug, tub and cup recycled helps keep valuable materials in use and out of the landfill.

☀️ With extreme heat expected this week, Rumpke crews may begin collection routes earlier than usual to help protect our essential workers.

To avoid missing your pickup, please place your trash and recycling at the curb the night before your scheduled collection day.

Thank you for your understanding and for helping us keep service running safely and efficiently. 🙌

☀️ Pool season is here, but before you clean out the shed or replace old supplies, remember: pool chemicals do NOT belong in the trash or recycling.

Items such as chlorine, bromine, pH adjusters, algaecides and clarifiers are considered household hazardous waste and require special handling.  Improper disposal can create safety risks for first responders, Rumpke employees, our facilities, and the environment.

If you have expired or unwanted pool chemicals, contact your local solid waste district to find a household hazardous waste collection facility near you.

🐝 This National Pollinator Week, remember that protecting pollinators starts with caring for the environment around us.

The photos featured in this post were all taken at Rumpke landfills, a reminder that pollinators can be found in unexpected places and that protecting their habitats is important everywhere. Through responsible recycling and proper trash disposal, Rumpke helps reduce litter, conserve resources and protect the natural spaces pollinators depend on.

Small actions can make a big impact. By disposing of waste properly, you're helping protect pollinators and preserve the environment for future generations.

🏆 Congratulations to our newest Driver Champions! 🏆

The first quarter of 2026 is off to a strong start, and we're proud to recognize the drivers who have gone above and beyond by achieving top safety scores and demonstrating excellence behind the wheel. Their commitment to safe driving practices helps protect our team, our customers and the communities we serve every day.

Please join us in celebrating John Patrick Sr., Ronnie Griffith, Dan Penner, Ray Mell, Phillip Smith, Randy Turner, Austin Nulf and John Murrell for their outstanding performance and dedication to safety. Thank you for leading by example and representing the best of Team Rumpke!

We’ve recently seen an increase in sports balls coming through our recycling facilities. Round items and fast-moving conveyors don’t mix. Balls can bounce, roll, and jam equipment, creating safety risks for our team.

To help keep everyone safe, please keep sports equipment out of your recycling bin. If it’s still in good shape, consider donating it! When in doubt, check our acceptable items list.

For the 7th year in a row, Rumpke has been named a U.S. Best Managed Company by Deloitte Private and the Wall Street Journal. This Platinum Honoree recognition wouldn’t be possible without the trust of our customers and the dedication of our team.

From investing in new technology and equipment to expanding recycling and waste solutions across our communities, we remain committed to delivering safe, reliable service every day.

Thank you for choosing Rumpke to serve your homes, businesses and neighborhoods. We’re proud to keep growing, improving and working hard to keep the communities we serve clean and green. ♻️

🔥🍖 Grilling season is finally here!

Whether you use charcoal or propane for your grilling needs, safe disposal is crucial. Improper disposal can pose safety risks for both our employees and the motoring public. Remember to soak used charcoal in water before disposal and explore options like propane tank trade-in programs at your local hardware stores. Let's grill safely and responsibly!

When you recycle with Rumpke, your efforts help save energy and support local jobs! We're proud to partner with end-product manufacturers within a 250-mile radius of our facilities to build a stronger circular economy. In fact, 80% of our material goes to Ohio companies!

posts.body:
July is Plastic Free July, a global movement that encourages everyone to reduce plastic waste. One simple way to make a difference is by recycling the plastics accepted in Rumpke's recycling program.

In 2025, Rumpke recycled more than 33,420 tons of plastic. With your help, we can recycle even more! Every bottle, jug, tub and cup recycled helps keep valuable materials in use and out of the landfill.

☀️ With extreme heat expected this week, Rumpke crews may begin collection routes earlier than usual to help protect our essential workers.

To avoid missing your pickup, please place your trash and recycling at the curb the night before your scheduled collection day.

Thank you for your understanding and for helping us keep service running safely and efficiently. 🙌

☀️ Pool season is here, but before you clean out the shed or replace old supplies, remember: pool chemicals do NOT belong in the trash or recycling.

Items such as chlorine, bromine, pH adjusters, algaecides and clarifiers are considered household hazardous waste and require special handling.  Improper disposal can create safety risks for first responders, Rumpke employees, our facilities, and the environment.

If you have expired or unwanted pool chemicals, contact your local solid waste district to find a household hazardous waste collection facility near you.

🐝 This National Pollinator Week, remember that protecting pollinators starts with caring for the environment around us.

The photos featured in this post were all taken at Rumpke landfills, a reminder that pollinators can be found in unexpected places and that protecting their habitats is important everywhere. Through responsible recycling and proper trash disposal, Rumpke helps reduce litter, conserve resources and protect the natural spaces pollinators depend on.

Small actions can make a big impact. By disposing of waste properly, you're helping protect pollinators and preserve the environment for future generations.

☀️ Pool season is here, but before you clean out the shed or replace old supplies, remember: pool chemicals do NOT belong in the trash or recycling.

Items such as chlorine, bromine, pH adjusters, algaecides and clarifiers are considered household hazardous waste and require special handling.  Improper disposal can create safety risks for first responders, Rumpke employees, our facilities, and the environment.

If you have expired or unwanted pool chemicals, contact your local solid waste district to find a household hazardous waste collection facility near you.

🏆 Congratulations to our newest Driver Champions! 🏆

The first quarter of 2026 is off to a strong start, and we're proud to recognize the drivers who have gone above and beyond by achieving top safety scores and demonstrating excellence behind the wheel. Their commitment to safe driving practices helps protect our team, our customers and the communities we serve every day.

Please join us in celebrating John Patrick Sr., Ronnie Griffith, Dan Penner, Ray Mell, Phillip Smith, Randy Turner, Austin Nulf and John Murrell for their outstanding performance and dedication to safety. Thank you for leading by example and representing the best of Team Rumpke!

We’ve recently seen an increase in sports balls coming through our recycling facilities. Round items and fast-moving conveyors don’t mix. Balls can bounce, roll, and jam equipment, creating safety risks for our team.

To help keep everyone safe, please keep sports equipment out of your recycling bin. If it’s still in good shape, consider donating it! When in doubt, check our acceptable items list.

For the 7th year in a row, Rumpke has been named a U.S. Best Managed Company by Deloitte Private and the Wall Street Journal. This Platinum Honoree recognition wouldn’t be possible without the trust of our customers and the dedication of our team.

From investing in new technology and equipment to expanding recycling and waste solutions across our communities, we remain committed to delivering safe, reliable service every day.

Thank you for choosing Rumpke to serve your homes, businesses and neighborhoods. We’re proud to keep growing, improving and working hard to keep the communities we serve clean and green. ♻️

🔥🍖 Grilling season is finally here!

Whether you use charcoal or propane for your grilling needs, safe disposal is crucial. Improper disposal can pose safety risks for both our employees and the motoring public. Remember to soak used charcoal in water before disposal and explore options like propane tank trade-in programs at your local hardware stores. Let's grill safely and responsibly!

When you recycle with Rumpke, your efforts help save energy and support local jobs! We're proud to partner with end-product manufacturers within a 250-mile radius of our facilities to build a stronger circular economy. In fact, 80% of our material goes to Ohio companies!
